name: The Kobeissi Letter
zh_summary: @KobeissiLetter：美國半導體及電子元件製造業生產者價格9月按年飆升26%，為紀錄上第4大升幅，並連續第6個月按年升至少25%；自2025年7月以來該指數上升31%，處於2007年1月以來第二高。
text:
Semiconductor prices are skyrocketing in the US:

Producer prices for semiconductor and other electronic component manufacturing surged +26% YoY in September, their 4th-largest increase on record.

This also marks their 6th consecutive YoY increase of at least +25%.

Since July 2025, the Producer Price Index for semiconductor and other electronic component manufacturing has risen +31%, to its 2nd-highest level since January 2007.

To put this into perspective, the index declined every year from 1994 to 2021.

Meanwhile, producer prices for electronic components and accessories soared +27% YoY last month, also marking their 6th consecutive YoY increase of at least +25%.

The AI Revolution is driving historic technology inflation.

name: Eva Fo𝕏 🦊 Claudius Nero's Legion
zh_summary: （由@elonmusk轉發）@EvaFox講述2002年初Elon準備創立SpaceX時發現Tom Mueller扛著80磅火箭引擎，這是業餘愛好者建造的最大液體燃料引擎，推力達13,000磅。Elon問他能否建造更大的，他們繪製了第一枚SpaceX火箭，Tom成為第1號員工並建造了Merlin、Kestrel和Draco引擎。
text:
In early 2002, Elon was preparing to launch SpaceX and searching for the people who could help him build a rocket from scratch. One Sunday in January 2002, he walked into a friend's rented warehouse in Huntington Beach and found Tom Mueller holding an 80-pound rocket engine on his shoulder, trying to bolt it to a frame. It was the largest liquid-fuel engine any amateur had ever built, with 13,000 pounds of thrust, made in Tom's spare time. 

Elon asked the main question  “Could you build something bigger?”

The next Sunday Elon came to his house. It was Super Bowl Sunday; they watched maybe one play, because they were too busy sketching the first SpaceX rocket.

Tom became SpaceX employee #1, and the man who built engines on weekends went on to build Merlin, Kestrel and Draco. 

Elon saw a person, not a résumé, someone who built rockets with his own hands simply because he loved them.

name: Kantro
zh_summary: 專注於基本屬性來創建籃子並推薦定位，而非標普500目標或行業呼籲。經濟和EPS數據上升、市場最風險偏好的階段現在可能已經過去。相同主題可以持續，但相同公司很少在整個週期中跑贏。市場週期的高品質基本面階段已進入幾個月。
text: Some focus on S&P 500 targets, others like to make sector calls, we focus on fundamental attributes to create baskets and recommend positioning. The upswing of eco and EPS data is where markets trade the most “risk-on.” That phase is now likely behind us. You can still be invested in the same themes across the cycle, but the same companies within those themes rarely outperform across the entire cycle. We’re a few months into the “higher-quality fundamentals” phase of the market cycle.
